name: Beskydda Grundar

facts.text: Beskydda Grundar is a level-41 morvalt (faction Morvalt Samhalle) in the far west of the Gripklosa Mountains (283,597/251,961) among thirteen morvalt beskydda (36-41); aggressive.
facts.source: runtime/data/opendaoc.sqlite3.db, Mob and NpcTemplate tables (0.37b world data)

facts.text: Swedish beskydda is 'to protect' and grund 'foundation'; the name would read 'protector of the foundations'.
Grundar as the keeper of the western morvalt's founding stone is Living Server lore.
The bergklan's attempt on the founding stone and the rusted lever beside it are Living Server lore.

story:
The western morvalt of Gripklosa set their fires on a stone, the bergklan say, a flat grey stone half-buried in the slope, and they guard it with the beskydda, the protectors, under a chief whose name is the work: Beskydda Grundar, protector of the foundations. The morvalt say the stone is where their first chief on Aegir stood when they came over the island, and that while it is guarded the morvalt cannot be driven off the island.

The bergklan do not believe it, and say so from a distance. The Valkyn, who were morvalt before the Troll Fathers tamed them, believe it and say nothing. Grundar stands on the stone among his protectors and does not leave it, and he fights strangers with all thirteen round him, because a protector who leaves the foundation has protected nothing. The bergklan say Grundar's protectors change, season by season, and Grundar never does.

Once, the bergklan of the eastern slopes tell, they tried to settle the matter. A band of their concocters went west with a sledge and an iron lever, meaning to dig the stone out of the slope and roll it down into the valley and see whether the morvalt went with it. They had the lever under its edge before the beskydda found them. Grundar came down off the stone to meet them, the only time anyone remembers him leaving it, and the bergklan who lived to tell it said that the moment his feet were off the stone all thirteen of his protectors stopped where they stood and turned to look at him. He went back up without striking a blow. The bergklan left the lever where it lay. It is rusted into the slope beside the stone now, and the morvalt hang their charms on it.
legend: Beskydda Grundar is a morvalt chief of the Morvalt Samhalle, a foe for a hardened band of veterans, in the far west of the Gripklosa Mountains, standing with thirteen morvalt beskydda, nearly his match or a good deal weaker. He's morvalt, so the camp is in it with him. Thirteen beskydda is a lot; work the edges of the camp first and draw him out on his own if you can. The camp sits on the far west edge of the mountains; there's not much else near it, so you can rest between draws.
